body:
## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:services` · `area:workflow`, into `pm:queue`. One PR under the cross-domain exception path, as #22725

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T11:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. The direction is ruled (maintainer 「同意 P1」, `6108375797` on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2057), so this grade sets only the lane, the priority and the order.

- **Why p1 and `target:v18`:** it is release-first, by the maintainer's rule 「发版本优先的都p1」.
  - Done-when item 4 retires #22725's `unstaffed` filter, an `IApprovalService` member and a REST query parameter that landed on the v18 line (PR #22775, `c1b7f2b168`) and are not yet published.
  - Retiring them before v18 publishes costs a revert. After it, the retirement is an ADR-0087 breaking change on a released contract.
  - The defect also blocks every fresh HotCRM install's default sign-offs.
- **Lane:** `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` is `domain:services`, and that lane claims it. Under the exception path, as #22725 did, it declares:
  - `packages/spec` (the `onEmptyApprovers` describe text and the retired member) and `packages/lint` (one rule's message) on #6017;
  - `packages/rest` (the retired query parameter) on its lane's seat post.
  - One PR, because the member's retirement and its REST door go together, and the slate change makes the filter obsolete in the same stroke.
- **Siblings, executed in this round as done-when item 8 directs:**
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#12102 closes `not_planned`, superseded by this card (`6108389248`'s pointer is on it);
  - objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2057 is already `pm:blocked` on this card.
- **The census first** (done-when item 4): a real consumer of the `unstaffed` member goes back to the director seat, as the card says.
- `Clause-②: yes`. It retires a published-schema member and changes who receives a request, so the changeset states FROM → TO.

Claim: PM loop round 4 · 2026-10-11T12:08Z
Session: `session_01CBAfsWMSfM3EToQGVStEcp`
Account: `os-project-manager` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22824-admin-rescue-named-slate`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22824`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#1` (seat post #6021)
Scope per the ruled direction P1 (maintainer 「同意 P1」, `6108375797` on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2057) and triage `6108769161`: done-when items 1–7 of the card body, as one PR under the cross-domain exception path triage named for this lane.
- An empty slate under `admin_rescue` opens on the request organization's tenant administrators, resolved through the same authority `isOverrideActor`'s tenant arm trusts (ADR-0095 D3), through the ordinary `approvers` expansion. ⛔ No second notion of "admin".
- Ordinary paths: My Pending, the bell, `approval.requested` and `decide` as an approval.
- Break-glass stays break-glass for its two cases.
- The #22725 `unstaffed` arm retires: the census comes first, and a real consumer goes back to the director seat.
- The protocol text and the lint message say what ships.
File surface, read on `origin/main` `efcbac73c`:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/`: `approval-service.ts` (node entry under `onEmptyApprovers`, the notification fan-out, the `unstaffed` arm of `listRequests` / `countRequests`), `approver-address.ts`, and tests beside them.
- Under the exception path, declared on the owning seat posts in this act:
  - `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts` (the `unstaffed` filter member retires) and `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` (the `onEmptyApprovers` describe text): `domain:spec`, on #6017;
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts` (the message only): `domain:spec`, on #6017;
  - `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` and its approvals filter test (the `unstaffed` query parameter retires), plus `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-unstaffed-arm.dogfood.test.ts` and its fixture (retire or rewrite to the named slate): `domain:cli`, on #6024;
  - `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`: `domain:devx`, on #6023.
- `.changeset/22824-*.md`, and the pending, unreleased `.changeset/22725-approvals-unstaffed-arm.md`: the arm it announces never ships, so it is withdrawn or rewritten in the same PR.
- ⛔ No change to `isOverrideActor`'s authority, to the C2/C3 epic's territory (`plugin-security` grant reads are read, ⛔ not edited), to the `fallback` / `auto_approve` / `fail` policies, or to objectui. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this surface: "no path-derived mandate"; the default tier). The two `packages/spec/src/**` hits are Clause-② SUSPECT surfaces, so the reviewer runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` after the dev, inside `batch:1`.
Clause-②: yes
- A published-schema contract member (`IApprovalService` `listRequests` / `countRequests`'s `unstaffed` filter) retires, and who receives an `admin_rescue` request changes (triage: "the changeset states FROM → TO").
Responsibility: `this repository's plugin-approvals: an empty slate under the default admin_rescue opens a request whose only approver is a type:value literal naming nobody | the #3424 break-glass override, plus the #22725 unstaffed queue arm, which needs a rescue arm in every downstream feature | every fresh HotCRM install's default sign-offs (hotcrm#2057, measured on 17.7.0): in nobody's My Pending, bell 0, nobody notified`
Thread-read: 6108769161
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `plugin-approvals`, `packages/rest`, the approval contract or schema, the lint rule or `approvals.mdx` (the open PRs' file lists, read at this stamp).
- #22725 / PR #22775 (the arm this retires) merged as `c1b7f2b168`. #22738 (`domain:engine`, `enrichRows`) is closed.
- This seat's own last dispatch, #22806 / PR #22822, merged as `efcbac73c`; nothing of this seat is in flight (`batch:1`).
